Unlike conventional straight-wall baskets, the IKAPE Step-Down Basket features a unique 58mm or 54mm opening that tapers to a 32mm base, creating a deeper coffee puck that promotes more even extraction, reduced channeling, and enhanced sweetness. The smaller internal diameter increases puck depth while allowing you to use a coarser grind size compared to traditional baskets. This slows water flow through the coffee bed, improving extraction uniformity and reducing harsh bitterness and astringency. The result is a richer, sweeter espresso with improved body, aroma, and mouthfeel. Designed to sit flush with the bottom of the portafilter, the IKAPE basket is compatible with standard bottomless and spouted portafilters without an extended tail, making it suitable for most tamping stations and portafilter holders. The tapered design naturally builds brewing pressure, making it possible to extract espresso without tamping when paired with the appropriate grind size. Alternatively, use your favourite WDT tool, distributor and tamper for even greater consistency. Available in two basket heights to suit different coffee doses, the IKAPE Variable Diameter Basket is ideal for espresso enthusiasts looking to maximise sweetness and extraction quality. Unlock sweeter, smoother espresso with the IKAPE Variable Diameter Espresso Portafilter Basket. Unlike conventional straight-wall baskets, the IKAPE Step-Down Basket features a unique 58mm or 54mm opening that tapers to a 32mm base, creating a deeper coffee puck that promotes more even extraction, reduced channeling, and enhanced sweetness.

The smaller internal diameter increases puck depth while allowing you to use a coarser grind size compared to traditional baskets.
